svg.title: Container diagram for Tollgate
svg.desc: Inside Tollgate: your Claude Code session asks the driver for each step and runs the hooks before each tool call. The driver runs the gate after each try and reaches the state folder only through the store. The store locks tests, signs records, and merges a ready change into your project.
svg.text: the parts inside it, and what flows between them
